blocks.title: HILUX — Let It Carry Your Load | Toyota Iraq Campaign Film

blocks.body: Directed by Rafat Mhalla and Mohammad Jalal
The campaign presents the HILUX as more than a powerful pickup. It is a reliable partner that supports people across their work, responsibilities and everyday journeys.
The campaign was extended across digital and social media through portrait-led visuals connecting HILUX with different people, professions and responsibilities.

As Creative Director at Fikra, I led the client communication, campaign development and internal creative process. Together with Mohammad Jalal, I coordinated the team's responsibilities and co-directed the campaign film.
